title: Anduril scramble text
description: Text that decodes itself: random letters flicker in each position and settle left to right into the real words, on load, each time it scrolls into view, or when a parent marked data-scramble-host is hovered.
notes: needs JavaScript (hydrate: visible); static HTML shows the plain text
put data-scramble-host on a card to scramble when the card (not just the text) is hovered
